name: Clarks Fork of the Yellowstone
blurb: South-central Montana's other Clarks Fork — Bridger and Fromberg water, not the Idaho canyon.

sections.notes: Bridger has an FWP-listed gravel ramp. Edgar Bridge Fishing Access is an agency-documented public access area, but its exact boat landing and carry are not confirmed. Check both ends during your shuttle. Irrigation diversions require current local guidance; unconfirmed town and bridge exits are not alternatives.
sections.distanceReview: River distance is being checked. Confirm trip length and timing with a current local guide before launching; a float-time estimate is not available for this stretch yet.
sections.routeReview: The available river-course lines cross a wooded island near Edgar and do not reliably follow the current channel. The access map is available, but a dotted river path and GPS time remaining are not available.

putInAccess.sourceName: Montana FWP Bridger Fishing Access Site 39754495
putInAccess.note: Current FWP site information confirms the public gravel-ramp facility. The unchanged agency coordinate falls within the campground/parking area, about 110 metres from the mapped river centerline. It is not a surveyed shoreline landing. Stable access ID and numeric coordinate preserved.
putInAccess.directions: Use Bridger Fishing Access Site off East Broadway, about half a mile east of Bridger. FWP lists a gravel boat ramp. The Area marker identifies the facility vicinity; locate the ramp and current water edge during your shuttle.

takeOutAccess.accessType: Public fishing-access area; exact boat landing unconfirmed
takeOutAccess.sourceName: Carbon County — Edgar Bridge Fishing Access designation, with FWP acquisition approval
takeOutAccess.note: FWP approved the Carbon County donation for public fishing and float access in December 2017. Carbon County designated the existing Wild Cat site as Edgar Bridge Fishing Access in April 2023. The 2026 Montana State Library cadastral record places FWP parcel 10062423404240000 beside the bridge. Its centroid provides approximate facility placement only; it does not establish a precise ramp, current shoreline connection or trailer suitability. The unrelated Edgar lagoon parcel is excluded.
takeOutAccess.directions: Edgar Bridge Fishing Access is beside the west end of the East Pryor Road bridge. The Area marker identifies the FWP parcel on the north side of the road. Confirm the public entrance and a usable landing during your shuttle before launching upstream; a completed ramp and exact carry are not confirmed. Do not park on the bridge or block the road.

mapAuditNote: Bridger and Edgar public access areas are supported by agency records and mapped approximately. Exact shoreline landings, trip distance and the full river-course line remain under review. Edgar is the county-designated FWP site, not an assumed town or bridge exit.
